Diagnosis.submission: Faulty component: the custom-service Deployment in namespace social-network. All 3 custom-service pods are stuck Pending (PodInitializing) and the Deployment has 0 available replicas with condition ProgressDeadlineExceeded; Prometheus alerts DeploymentNotReady, KubePodNotReady (x3), PendingPodsDetected (x3) and PodStatusError (x3) are firing for it. Root cause: a non-terminating init container named hang-init (busybox, command `sleep infinity`) was added to the pod template; it never exits, so the custom-service-main container can never start. The rollout strategy was also set to maxSurge=0%/maxUnavailable=100%, so when the template changed the controller killed the previously healthy replicas (old ReplicaSet custom-service-5c68f797 scaled to 0) and replaced them with pods that hang forever in Init, taking custom-service fully down. The rest of the social-network microservices (compose-post, user-timeline, home-timeline, nginx-thrift, etc.) were checked and are currently serving requests correctly; secondary noise observed: app pods cannot export traces because otel-collector is unresolvable from the social-network namespace, and brief Thrift read-timeouts in nginx-thrift occurred during the load test.
